caption: The drawing depicts a single sculptural object that resembles a stylized pineapple. The object is composed of three main sections: a broad, textured base; a rounded, decorated midsection; and a top portion that tapers upward and flares outward. The base is octagonal with beveled edges and displays a stone-like, cracked appearance in shades of gray and brown. The midsection of the sculpture is bulbous and intricately patterned with vertical, curved, red-brown lines on a pale, ivory background. Above this section, the sculpture forms a diamond-patterned surface in alternating light and dark brown tones, depicting the surface texture of a pineapple. The top narrows and curves outward, with elongated, vertical, red-brown markings on a pale background, giving a leafy appearance. The entire object stands upright and is centrally placed against a plain, light beige background.
title: Gate Post Top
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
